gate_cvt.zero_useful_contact_run_definition: No positive projection of actual contact force toward evaluator goal for the unchanged contact_loss_dwell frames; descriptive, not a controller guard
gate_cvt.alignment: row time is pre-control; force is start-of-control-hold contact; true_velocity is post-physics; phase active count comes from previous diagnostics
gate_cvt.limits: Designated pushers are not actual contacts. Force report is before ground friction. Time ordering is not causal attribution. Reconstructed reference velocity uses saved readouts and has floating-point roundoff; not a new sensor recording.
